texts.facts: Detailed Accident Report was filed by police in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act in respect of injuries sustained by Sh. Mohit (hereinafter called the claimant) on account of alleged rash and negligent driving of vehicle bearing Registration No. Gj02Xx 8798 (hereinafter called the offending vehicle) Mohit(Dar) vs Ajit Singh(358/17Slc) on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147121396/ 1 driven by Sh.Ajit Yadav (hereinafter called the Respondent No.1) and owned by Sh. Devender S/o Sh. Pratap Bhai Chaudhary (hereinafter called the Respondent No.2) and insured with United India General Insurance Company Ltd. (hereinafter called the insurance company), which is being treated as Claim Petition in view of the provisions contained in such Act. 2. Preliminary information regarding accident in question was received at PS Sun Light Colony vide DD No. 13A dated 19.09.2017, upon receipt of which HC Harbir Singh alongwith Ct. Praveen proceeded to the spot of accident at Bala Saheb Gurudwara, Ring Road, New Delhi, where they found a truck bearing registration No. GJ02XX 8798, an Auto with registration No. DL1RS 0190 and car bearing registration no. HR 55Y 9367 in accidental condition. It appeared that the truck had hit auto rickshaw as well as car from the back because of which both the vehicles were badly damaged. It was also revealed that the auto driver and the passenger therein were injured due to impact of the MACT No. 696/2024 Mohit vs. Ajit Singh Yadav Page No. 2 of 24 accident and were already taken to hospital by PCR. Subsequently, information was received about the injured having been admitted to AIIMS Trauma Center for the purpose of treatment. HC Harbir Singh then proceeded to AIIMS Trauma Center, where he was told that Yogender S/o Sh. Ashok with MLC No. 500049451 did not undertake any treatment and left the hospital. MLC pertaining to three injured persons namely Dharmender, Mohit and Munender @ Devender travelling as passengers in an auto rickshaw were obtained. Statement of Munender @ Devender Singh pertaining to the occurrence of accident was recorded, wherein he narrated that auto rickshaw and car were hit from back by speeding and negligently driven truck on 19.09.2017 at about 3.40 a.m. because of which auto driver as well as the passengers got injured whereas auto as well as car got badly damaged. He also stated that car driver Aslam S/o Munna Lal had made a PCR call and that is how he alongwith other injured persons were shifted to hospital. He also mentioned that the truck was speedily driven by Ajit Yadav S/o Sh.Ram Narayan specifying that the said driver alongwith his Adhar card was left in the custody of car driver pleading that necessary legal action be taken against the truck driver for causing accident on account of rash and negligent driving. FIR was registered on the basis of statement as well as MLC collected. Documents pertaining to offending vehicle were taken into police possession and were got verified which were found to be valid. Statement of truck owner Sh. Devender Chaudhary was also recorded, who stated that the offending vehicle was driven MACT No. 696/2024 Mohit vs. Ajit Singh Yadav Page No. 3 of 24 by Ajit Yadav on the date of accident. Mechanical Inspection of all the accidental vehicles was got conducted. The nature of injury of injured Dharmender was opined to be simple and grievous for injured Munender @ Devender and Mohit. Upon completion of investigation, chargesheet was filed under Sections 279/337/338 IPC against driver. DAR was filed by Investigating Officer before this Tribunal. 3. All the respondents appeared before the court and copy of DAR was supplied to them. 4. Written statement was filed by respondent no.3, wherein general defence was taken, admitting the validity and genuineness of the insurance policy. 5. Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 stopped appearing in the court and also did not file any reply and Mohit(Dar) vs Ajit Singh(358/17Slc) on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147121396/ 2 therefore, their right to file reply was closed vide order dated 31.0.2019. 6. From the pleadings of parties, following issues were framed by Ld. Predecessor of this Tribunal vide order dated 31.08.2019 : i). Whether the injured Munender @ Devender and Mohit suffered grievous injuries and Dharmender suffered simple injury, in a road traffic accident on 09.09.2017 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle bearing no. GJ02XX8798 driven by R1 and owned by R2 and insured with R3? OPP. ii). Relief. MACT No. 696/2024 Mohit vs. Ajit Singh Yadav Page No. 4 of 24 7. Matter was then listed for evidence of claimant, however, no evidence was adduced on behalf of claimant and PE was accordingly closed. None of the respondents chose to lead evidence in their defence. Accordingly, RE was closed. Ld. Counsel for insurance company stated that matter may be disposed off on the basis of material available on record.
